facts.text: X-Ray / Gamma-Ray Spectrometer (XGRS) was deployed at 433 Eros — Himeros Region during NEAR Shoemaker in 2001.
NaI(Tl) scintillation detector and gas proportional counters measuring cosmic-ray-induced fluorescent elemental emissions.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Confirmed Eros is an undifferentiated primitive ordinary chondrite, fundamentally identical to meteorites found on Earth.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at 433 Eros — Himeros Region.
Settled the decades-long scientific dispute connecting S-type asteroids to ordinary chondritic meteorites.
